text: After this you can arrange a six-stage audit process.
The final step occurs after the report is delivered.

items: Agree the decision and scope: The objective sets the boundary for all later work.
Request records and plan instruments: Early evidence and preparation guide an efficient visit.
Inspect systems and interview staff: Field observations test the supplied records.
Calculate and qualify opportunities: Analysis follows reliable data collection.
Explain findings in a report: The report connects each recommendation with evidence.
Arrange verification and follow-up: Post-report checks can confirm implementation and outcomes.

text: Follow-up checks whether recommendations were addressed.
